attention1.ptxt: If you suck at the nozzle on the EVAP canister, you will inhale harmful fuel vapor that may be present inside the canister.
Never suck at any of the nozzles on the EVAP canister.

s1.ptxt: Check outside of EVAP canister visually.
Check that there is no restriction of flow through purge port (1) and air port (2) when air is blown (4) into tank port (3).
Check EVAP canister for air leakage according to the following procedure.

s2.ptxt: Plug purge port (1) and air port (2) using rubber plug (3).
Connect hose (4) and special tool to tank port (5) and set the tool in “VACUUM” mode.

attention3.ptxt: Before using special tool (vacuum pump gauge), read its Operator’s Manual to know how to use it.

s2.ptxt: Apply specified negative pressure to EVAP canister for one minute.

s1.ptxt: If faulty condition is found, replace EVAP canister.
